name: brdcomp-popover
title: Popover
description: A floating panel anchored to a trigger, useful for lightweight forms or contextual info. It can contain any content.

examples.title: Popover content
examples.code:
import { Popover, PopoverTrigger, PopoverContent } from "@/components/ui/popover"

<Popover>
  <PopoverTrigger>Open</PopoverTrigger>
  <PopoverContent>Popover content</PopoverContent>
</Popover>
